primaryTextRead.text: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list, “Gazez” subsection, lines 2699–2707; lines 2703–2705 quote the Ephah/Haran/Moza/Gazez relationships and cite 1 Chronicles 2:46. The standalone Ephah article, lines 110–116 and 127, identifies a male son of Midian and explicitly distinguishes Caleb’s concubine as another use.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 人物一覧のGazez節は、カレブの側女エパがハラン、モツァ、ガゼズの母であると1歴代誌2:46に結び付ける。単独Ephah記事はミディアンの子という別人。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessment: Related-section: exact same named woman is included in a passage-focused list; standalone same-title article is a different male person.
